meta.name: CCNL Industria Turistica (Federturismo Confindustria)
meta.sector: turismo — alberghi, campeggi, villaggi e strutture ricettive

family.reason: Federturismo agreement for the tourism industry: hotels, campsites and holiday villages.

sources.title: A1 and D2 confirmed at 01/05/2026. Intermediate levels derived via parametric ratio and independently verified to <EUR 0.02.

notes.text: CCNL H05B — Federturismo Confindustria. Conglobated model. 9 levels: D2-D1-C3-C2-C1-B2-B1-A2-A1. Divisor 172, 14 months. Function allowances: A1+75 EUR, A2+70 EUR (14 months). Seniority 36-month cadence, max 6.
INPS: uses 2026-terziario.json (TaxSector.TERZIARIO). Same classification as H052 turismo-federalberghi.
SALARY VALUES: parametric derivation verified to <0.02 EUR accuracy across all levels. A1 and D2 taken directly from source; all others derived via stable level-coefficient ratios.

PRE-2025 NOT MODELLED: the CCNL H05B renewal starts Jan 2025; series begins 2025-01-01. Prior CCNL salary tables exist but are out of scope for the current engine version (coverage starts at renewal date). This is a deliberate scope decision.

SENIORITY CADENCE (Art. 114, p. 91 of the 2016 definitive text): 'A tutto il personale verranno riconosciuti sei scatti triennali [...] Gli scatti triennali decorreranno dal primo giorno del mese immediatamente successivo a quello in cui si compie il triennio': 36 months, six increments; the renewal of 21 December 2024 does not amend art. 114.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: six triennial increments (art. 114); read on 2026-11-06.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP: under_classification 2 levels below destination is the contract rule. Modelled as 100% passthrough: the apprentice is paid the destination level. The engine can express it (apprenticeship type under_classification, levels_below relative to each destination level), but the periods are not sourced (review of 2026-10-30)

limitation.remediation: Source the periods of the under-classification (Art. on apprendistato professionalizzante) and model them as an under_classification track with levels_below 2 (and 1 where due); until then record the limitation on the apprentice path (contract_types apprentice).

notes.text: TRATTAMENTO INTEGRATIVO SPECIALE (L. 199/2025 art. 1 cc. 18-21): for the work of 1 January - 30 September 2026 of a worker who asked for it (PriorYearTaxFacts.special_supplement_requested) with 2025 employment income up to 40,000 EUR, in an employer of food service, tourism or thermal establishments (EmployerProfile.activity), the engine pays 15% of the gross pay of the night hours and of the holiday overtime (AdE circ. 26/E/2023 par. 2: 'calcolata sulla retribuzione lorda'), outside income, as a credit the employer recovers in F24 (capability special_supplement).

The cached collective agreement, Art. 182 (PDF p. 160), abolishes the seniority prize from 31 May 1986 but preserves rights of workers then in service. Annex 9 (PDF p. 316) prints hotel-sector awards of 1, 1.5, 2 and 3 monthly pays after 10, 15, 20 and 30 continuous years, plus further accrued fractions on departure after year 10. A continuously employed 2026 worker in the grandfathered cohort has at least 40 years of service: the 30-year milestone has already passed, but settlement or accrued rights cannot be ruled out. Continued force in the current renewal, historical settlement, and the basis and treatment of departure fractions are not established here. An annual loyalty award would incorrectly recur and cover new hires.

limitation.remediation: Confirm continued force in the current renewal and determine whether a worker in service on 31 May 1986 has unpaid awards or departure fractions; source settlement history and the Art. 109 pay basis before modelling one-off entitlements. Do not pay new hires or recur milestones annually.

source_document.title: Tourism industry collective agreement (CNEL archive)

location.section: Art. 182 - Premio di anzianità; Allegato 9 - Premio di anzianità aziende alberghiere
location.quote: Vengono fatti salvi i diritti acquisiti da lavoratori in servizio al 31 maggio 1986 per i quali l’istituto continua a produrre i suoi effetti (vedi Allegato 9).

provenance.transformation: In 2026 the protected continuously employed cohort exceeds 30 years; past awards and departure fractions may still require individual settlement, but this text does not establish continued force in the current renewal.

reviews.scope: The paga base nazionale conglobata (art. 110) of the nine levels against the Federturismo circular of 16 January 2025 that prints the tables agreed in the renewal of 21 December 2024.
findings: Federturismo Confindustria, a signatory, prints in its circular of 16 January 2025 the paga base nazionale conglobata of art. 110 'condivise' by the parties for 01/01/2025, 01/06/2025, 01/05/2026 and 01/04/2027 (PDF pp. 1-2, rows A1-D1 on p. 1, D2 on p. 2): the 36 minimi of the file are checked against the general table, not the separate tables of the imprese di viaggi e turismo e congressi (different tranches) or the aziende alberghiere minori (art. 178).
The file's values were derived parametrically from A1 and D2 (an aggregator); 11 of them differ by one cent from the printed table and are corrected.
The ruleset names this source, published by Federturismo Confindustria, a signatory: source_type contracting_party.

reviews.scope: Apprentice seniority: artt. 40 and 106 of the testo definitivo of 14 November 2016 (pp. 56, 88).
findings: The apprentice's retribuzione is 'quella minima contrattualmente prevista' for his level, apart from the scatti of art. 106: none during the apprenticeship.

reviews.scope: Grandfathered seniority prize in Art. 182 and hotel awards in Annex 9 of the cached agreement; current-renewal status remains unconfirmed.
findings: Art. 182 (PDF p. 160) preserves rights of workers in service on 31 May 1986. Annex 9 (PDF p. 316) lists one-off hotel milestones and departure fractions after year 10. A continuously employed 2026 worker has passed year 30; accrued rights and settlement require worker-specific facts.

[Art. 106] Di norma, la retribuzione del lavoratore è distinta nelle seguenti voci: a) paga base nazionale conglobata [...] c) eventuali scatti di anzianità

provenance.transformation: The apprentice is paid the minimum of the level he is classified at, which art. 106 keeps apart from the scatti: no increment during the apprenticeship; the period counts for seniority once the employment goes on (art. 40).

location.section: Art. malattia — integrazione al 100% per 180 giorni

provenance.transformation: Comporto of several illnesses (2026-11-01): the comporto of 180 days counts the sick days of every episode of the calendar year. Source: https://az-apim-cne-sa-0002-lgc-we.azure-api.net/ricerca-api/ricerca/pubblica/accordi/scarica/accordi/154401, p. 130 (sha256 2c01fa555644de38b31a327c517edd8f2888545a41a9b28f20eeccdecf0758fc): 'In caso di malattia accertata o di infortunio il personale che non sia in periodo di prova o di preavviso ha diritto alla conservazione del posto per un periodo di centottanta giorni per anno, intendendosi per tale il periodo compreso tra il 1° gennaio e il 31 dicembre. Ove il lavoratore si ammali o si infortuni più volte nel corso dell’anno i relativi periodi di assenza sono cumulabili agli effetti del raggiungimento del termine massimo di conservazione del posto di cui al precedente comma.'

location.section: Art. 86 - Festività nazionali ed infrasettimanali; Art. 87 - Festività soppressa; Art. 108 - Determinazione della retribuzione giornaliera
location.quote: A tutto il personale assente nelle giornate di festività, per riposo settimanale, malattia, infortunio, dovrà essere corrisposta una giornata di retribuzione contrattuale senza alcuna maggiorazione. [Art. 87] Al lavoratore assente nella stessa giornata per riposo settimanale, dovrà essere corrisposta una giornata di retribuzione contrattuale senza alcuna maggiorazione. [Art. 108] La retribuzione giornaliera si ottiene dividendo la retribuzione mensile per ventisei.

provenance.transformation: The national and weekday holidays of art. 86 (but the Patrono della Città) and 4 November (art. 87) falling on the worker's weekly rest day (Employment.weekly_rest_day): one day of the monthly pay of the chain over 26 (art. 108). The statutory holidays on a Sunday stay paid by L. 260/1949 art. 5 when the rest day is another day.
provenance.note: Text layer of the 2016 definitive text; the renewal of 21 December 2024 was read only through the Federturismo circular of 16 January 2025 on the pay tables. 4 October, a holiday from 2026 (L. 151/2025), is not in the list: its rest day stays open. The Patrono is not in the national calendar and is not paid. A rotating rest day is not modelled. The absence for sickness or injury on a holiday (same comma) is left to the sickness treatment.
